definition.simple: A period when farming improved drastically by using new science and better seeds, producing a lot more food.
definition.academic: A large increase in crop production in developing countries achieved by the use of artificial fertilizers, pesticides, and high-yield crop varieties.

examples: Using High Yielding Variety (HYV) wheat seeds in India to multiply the harvest.

common_misconceptions: Students think it literally means planting everything green. It refers to a massive agricultural revolution, not just color.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student what they think a 'revolution' in farming would look like.
